name: ema-forge-cloudflare-study
description: Host an EMA Forge participant study and store responses in a private Cloudflare R2 bucket.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Create a unique random secret of at least 32 characters. You will enter it on /admin to install the study and export responses. EMA Forge never receives it.

STUDY_DATA.description: Private R2 storage for the installed study file and participant response records. Do not enable public bucket access.
